enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer’s unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Tactical Perfection
enhancements.body: Emperor’s Children model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Loathsome Dexterity
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

rule.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship
rule.body:
Each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, select one of the abilities below. While resolving those attacks, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have that ability:
▪ [LETHAL HITS]
▪ [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

stratagems.name: Deft Parry
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Incessant Violence
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Cruel Bladesman
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Terrifying Spectacle
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.name: Cut Down the Weak
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (you can only select a VEHICLE if it is a WALKER) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.name: Death Ecstasy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Faultless Opportunist
enhancements.body:
EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**, regardless of any other uses of that **Stratagem** this phase. If you do:
▪ That use is -1 CP.
▪ That use does not prevent any uses of that **Stratagem** on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Blinding Speed
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Distortion
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Rise to the Challenge
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer can fight one additional time. When doing so, you can select one ability using the Exquisite Swordsmanship Detachment rule to apply to those attacks.

rule.name: Mechanised Murder
rule.body: Each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model from your army makes an attack, if it is a TRANSPORT model or disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Dynamic Breakthrough
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.name: Ceaseless Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Advance and Claim
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that has one or more Tormentors units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: On to the Next
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Outflanking Strike
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army, or up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DEDICATED TRANSPORTS from your army.
stratagems.effect: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Reactive Disembarkation
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

enhancements.name: Sublime Prescience
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that TRANSPORT on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Spearhead Striker
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Each time the bearer disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit and enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Accomplished Tactician
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per turn, in your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, you can select one friendly Emperor’s Children unit within 9" of the bearer that was hit by one or more of those attacks, then select one friendly TRANSPORT that unit is wholly within 6" of and is able to embark within. That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can embark within that Transport.

enhancements.name: Heretek Adept
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

rule.name: Internal Rivalries
rule.body:
Emperor’s Children Character units from your army can ignore any or all modifiers to their Move characteristic and any or all modifiers to Advance and Charge rolls made for them.

At the start of the battle, your WARLORD’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. The first time in each player’s turn that an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, after resolving all of its attacks, that CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s new Favoured Champions, replacing the old one.

Each time a model in your army’s Favoured Champions unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Devoted Duellists
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Heightened Jealousy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: Your army’s Favoured Champions unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Refusal to Be Outdone
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit can re-roll **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.

stratagems.name: Diabolic Majesty
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Beautiful Death
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Vengeful Surge
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit this phase has shot.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that **surge move**.

enhancements.name: Eager to Prove
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. While the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Repulsed by Weakness
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit Falls Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.name: Proud and Vainglorious
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. You can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for the bearer’s unit. While the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Slayer of Champions
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

rule.name: Eager to Kill
rule.body: When a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is set up, that unit has +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]** until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Delight in Agony
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Psychedelic Soulflame
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks have +2 S.

stratagems.name: Warp Plunge
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.

enhancements.name: Cacophonic Accompaniment
enhancements.body:
LORD KAKOPHONIST model only.
▪ This model has [core:Deep Strike].
▪ This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

enhancements.name: Frenzied Ferocity
enhancements.body: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rule.name: Frantic Focus
rule.body: When a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that unit’s BATTLELINE models’ attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Possessive Mania
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Agonised Cacophony
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

stratagems.name: Absolute Sensory Overload
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.
stratagems.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:hidden:hidden]**.

enhancements.name: Euphoric Crown
enhancements.body: LORD EXULTANT model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Howling Plate
enhancements.body: LORD EXULTANT model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +1 AP.

rule.name: Entitled to Victory
rule.body: Friendly FLAWLESS BLADES units have [core:Fights First].

stratagems.name: Honour Is for Fools
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Single-minded Strike
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a **[gloss:charge-move:Charge move]**.
stratagems.target: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).

stratagems.name: Intoxicated by Triumph
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**.
stratagems.target: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Eager Patrons
enhancements.body: FLAWLESS BLADES unit only. This unit has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Beguiling Grotesquerie
enhancements.body: FLAWLESS BLADES unit only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with **[gloss:snap-shooting:snap shooting]** attacks.

On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

abilities.name: Regenerating Gene-mass

Until the end of the turn, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. The same enemy unit can only be affected by this ability once per turn.

wargearAbilities.name: Flare Launcher
wargearAbilities.text: The bearer’s unit has the SMOKE keyword and you can target it with the Smokescreen Stratagem for 0CP.

wargearAbilities.name: Spotter
wargearAbilities.text: The bearer’s ranged weapons have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 3+.

wargearAbilities.name: Survey Augur

Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS model makes an attack against that unit, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Any number of models can each have their heavy mining laser replaced with one of the following:

Any number of models can each have their flare launcher replaced with one of the following:

▪ 1 survey augur

wargearAbilities.name: Cult Icon
wargearAbilities.text: In your Command phase, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit. If the bearer’s unit is within range of an objective marker you control, you can return up to 3 destroyed models to that unit instead. This ability cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER models in Attached units and any [ONE SHOT] weapons equipped by returned models that were shot before they were destroyed are still considered to have been shot.

For every 5 models in this unit, up to 3 Acolyte Hybrids can each have their autopistol and cult claws and knife replaced with 1 heavy mining tool.
The Acolyte Leader’s cult claws and knife can be replaced with 1 Leader's bio-weapons.

datasheets.name: Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers

abilities.name: Industrialised Destruction
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If the target of that attack is an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

wargearAbilities.name: Cult Icon
wargearAbilities.text: In your Command phase, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit. If the bearer’s unit is within range of an objective marker you control, you can return up to 3 destroyed models to that unit instead. This ability cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER models in Attached units and any [ONE SHOT] weapons equipped by returned models that were shot before they were destroyed are still considered to have been shot.

datasheets.loadout: **Every model is equipped with:** hand flamer; cult claws and knife.

For every 5 models in this unit, up to 2 Acolyte Hybrids can each have their hand flamer replaced with 1 demolition charges
The Acolyte Leader’s cult claws and knife can be replaced with 1 Leader’s bio-weapons.

datasheets.name: Acolyte Iconward

abilities.name: Nexus of Devotion
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If that unit has the Hybrid Metamorphs keyword, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

abilities.name: Summon the Cult
abilities.text: Once per battle, when you have to remove a Cult Ambush marker because your opponent has moved too close to it, if one or more models from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, you can use this ability. If you do, instead of removing that marker, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield that is within 12" of a model from your army with this ability and more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, this ability is not considered to have been used and that marker is removed as normal).

datasheets.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** autopistol; cult claws.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

datasheets.name: Atalan Jackals

abilities.name: Outrider Gangs
abilities.text: Each time you use the Cult Ambush ability to set this unit back up on the battlefield, in addition to the normal rules, all of its models must be set up wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and at least one of its models must be touching one of your Cult Ambush markers (that marker is then removed from the battlefield). If this cannot be done, this unit cannot be set back up.

abilities.name: Demolition Run
abilities.text: Once per turn, in your Movement phase, when this unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of and visible to this unit and roll one D6 for each ATALAN JACKALS model in this unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

datasheets.loadout:

**Every Atalan Jackal is equipped with:** Atalan small arms; close combat weapon.

**Every Atalan Wolfquad is equipped with:** Atalan small arms; heavy stubber; close combat weapon.

For every 4 Atalan Jackals in this unit, 1 Atalan Jackal's Atalan small arms can be replaced with 1 grenade launcher.

Any number of Atalan Wolfquads can each have their heavy stubber replaced with one of the following:
▪ 1 Atalan incinerator
▪ 1 mining laser

datasheets.name: Benefictus

abilities.name: Bio-horror Disruption (Psychic)
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

abilities.name: Psionic Shield (Psychic)
abilities.text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, this model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

datasheets.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** Psionic Cascade; close combat weapon.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

datasheets.name: Biophagus

abilities.name: Twisted Science
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

abilities.name: Biological Warfare
abilities.text: Once per battle, when this model's unit is selected to fight, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Damage characteristics of its injector goad by 3.

wargearAbilities.name: Alchemicus Familiar
wargearAbilities.text:
Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit is selected to fight, the bearer can use its alchemicus familiar. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets an INFANTRY unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

**Designer’s Note:** Place an Alchemicus Familiar token next to the bearer, removing it once this ability has been used.

datasheets.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** autopistol; chemical vials; injector goad; alchemicus familiar.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

armyRule.name: Cult Ambush
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, you start the battle with a number of Resurgence points, depending on the battle size, as shown below:
▪ **Incursion:** 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Strike Force:** 10 Resurgence points.
▪ **Onslaught:** 14 Resurgence points.

Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model (excluding CHARACTER models) in that unit has this ability, you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points shown below based on that unit's Starting Strength (not including attached CHARACTER models):
▪ **Aberrants:** 5 models — 4 Resurgence points; 10 models — 8 Resurgence points.
▪ **Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers, Hybrid Metamorphs:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 4 Resurgence points.
▪ **Atalan Jackals:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Neophyte Hybrids:** 10 models — 3 Resurgence points; 20 models — 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Purestrain Genestealers:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 6 Resurgence points.

If you do:
▪ Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit (excluding CHARACTER models), in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
▪ Place one Cult Ambush marker (see below) anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed).

### Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn. Units in Cult Ambush are not automatically destroyed at the end of the third battle round.

### Cult Ambush Markers
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of your opponent's next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush to make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**. For that **ingress move**, set that unit up with at least one model in that unit in base contact with that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield). Units in Cult Ambush can make an **ingress move** in the first battle round using this rule.

rule.name: Integrated Tactics & BROOD BROTHERS
rule.body:
### Integrated Tactics
Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (see below) is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to that unit. If you do, until the end of the phase, models in that ASTRA MILITARUM unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and that enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire. While an enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire, each time a GENESTEALER CULTS model from your army targets that enemy unit with a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

### BROOD BROTHERS
You can include ASTRA MILITARUM units in your army, even though they do not have the GENESTEALER CULTS Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:
▪ Incursion: Up to 500 pts
▪ Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts
▪ Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts
A GENESTEALER CULTS model must be your WARLORD, and ASTRA MILITARUM models from your army lose the Voice of Command ability if they have it. You cannot include units with any of the following keywords in your army using this rule: AIRCRAFT; COMMISSAR; EPIC HERO; MILITARUM TEMPESTUS; OGRYN; RATLING; TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER; MINISTORUM PRIEST.

Until the end of the phase, models in those units can only make attacks that target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). rule.body:
At the end of your Movement phase, for each TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit from your army, you can select one friendly Genestealer Cults unit (excluding Purestrain Genestealer and Patriarch units) and one friendly Tyranids unit each within 9" of and visible to that SYNAPSE unit. If you do, that GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army suffers D3+1 mortal wounds and one model in the selected TYRANIDS unit regains up to that many lost wounds and until the start of your next Movement phase, each time a model in the selected TYRANIDS unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

TYRANIDS units from your army have the following ability:

**Catalyst (Aura):** While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

▪ You can use this part of this **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**. If you do:
▪ Your unit can re-roll **Charge rolls**.
▪ Your unit __must__ end that **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** engaged with an enemy unit engaged with that friendly TYRANIDS unit.

stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Psi Surge
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit’s Catalyst ability by 3.
stratagems.restrictions: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.

stratagems.name: Resistance Tunnels
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS or TYRANIDS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Auger
enhancements.body: TYRANIDS model only. Each time the bearer would regain one or more lost wounds from the Psionic Parasitism Detachment rule, it regains up to twice that number of lost wounds instead.

enhancements.name: Enraptured Damnation
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Vanguard Tyrant
enhancements.body: Winged Hive Tyrant model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Inhuman Integration
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 6" of one or more friendly TYRANIDS units.

rule.name: A Perfect Ambush
rule.body: Each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Trap
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Primed and Readied
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.name: Tunnel Crawlers
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: Return to the Shadows
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Lying in Wait
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS BATTLELINE unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting your unit up using a Cult Ambush marker, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Cult Ambush marker and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: A Deadly Snare
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Prowling Agitant
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

enhancements.name: A Chink in Their Armour
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Each time the bearer is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

enhancements.name: Our Time Is Nigh
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit declares a charge, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2 to Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Assassination Edict
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll

rule.name: Rapid Takeover
rule.body: While a GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED/VEHICLE model from your army is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to its **[gloss:objective:Objective]** Control characteristic. In addition, at the end of your Command phase, if one or more Atalan Jackals units from your army are within range of an **objective** you control, that **objective** remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that **objective** marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Devoted Crew
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Goliath Rockgrinder or Goliath Truck unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Deft Manoeuvring
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Close-Range Shoot-Out
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or GENESTEALER CULTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".

stratagems.name: Along Shadowed Trails
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Rapid Feint
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Encircling the Prey
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or GENESTEALER CULTS VEHICLE unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Serpentine Tactics
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Cartographic Data-leech
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. While the bearer is embarked within a TRANSPORT, each time that TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by that TRANSPORT as a result of the Firing Deck ability by 1.

enhancements.name: Starfall Shells
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with a cult sniper rifle. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Assault Commando
enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a ranged attack, if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rule.name: Unquestioning Fanaticism
rule.body: For each ACOLYTE HybRIDS, HybRID METAMORPHS and NEOPHYTE HybRIDS unit from your army, while one or more CHARACTER models are leading that unit, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for it. If that CHARACTER model is a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD, that model has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability while leading that unit.

stratagems.name: Frenzied Devotion
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding CHARACTERS) in your unit by 1 and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.name: Vengeance for the Martyr!
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.target: One other GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the destroyed model was a Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: The Downtrodden Rise
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can set up your unit on the battlefield without using a Cult Ambush marker. When doing so, set up your unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Transcendent Celerity
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: Tireless Fervour
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect:
▪ If your unit made an advance/**[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]** this turn, that advance/**fall-back move** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.
▪ When your unit **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**, you can use this part of this **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**. If you do:
▪ Your unit can re-roll **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ Your unit __must__ end that charge move engaged with an enemy unit engaged with a friendly CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.name: The Path of Anguish
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT), When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Gene-sire’s Reliquant
enhancements.body: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only. You can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Denunciator of Tyrants
enhancements.body: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Deeds That Speak to the Masses
enhancements.body: Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward model only. You start the battle with 2 additional Resurgence points.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Inspiration
enhancements.body: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

rule.name: Killer Reputation
rule.body:
▪ Friendly KELERMORPH/LOCUS/REDUCTUS SABOTEUR/SANCTUS models have KILLER.
▪ Friendly KILLER models’ attacks can:
▪ Re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
▪ Re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Living Up to Legend
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit has attacked, if those attacks **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** an enemy unit or an enemy CHARACTER model.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect: Each **[gloss:visible:visible]** friendly **[gloss:battle-shocked:Battle-shocked]** GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of your unit is no longer **Battle-shocked**.

stratagems.name: Surging Broodworship
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks made by KILLER models in your unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

stratagems.name: Loyal to the End
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly KILLER unit.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a KILLER model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6:
▪ On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
▪ On a 2+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

enhancements.name: Gene-tailored Toxins
enhancements.body: LOCUS/SANCTUS model only. This model’s attacks have +1 D.

enhancements.name: Contraband Munitions
enhancements.body: KELERMORPH/REDUCTUS SABOTEUR model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +2 S.

rule.name: Enemy Within
rule.body: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** PURESTRAIN GENESTEALER units can be placed in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.

stratagems.name: Lurk and Strike
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Crawling Horror
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has -6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]** until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Inhuman Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.target: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Mark of the Star Children
enhancements.body:
PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit only. This unit has:
▪ +1 T.
▪ 4+ Sv.
▪ This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Talons of the Sire
enhancements.body: PATRIARCH model only. This unit’s attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

rule.name: Hordes of the Faithful
rule.body:
In your Command phase, if a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**, that unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** 3 wounds.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **HOSTS** tag and cannot be taken with another **HOSTS** **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Eyes of the Cult
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**.
stratagems.effect: Enemy units within that **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]** have +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

stratagems.name: Fanatical Hail
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can re-roll Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Slunk from the Underbelly
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit with every model within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**.
stratagems.target: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that unit has attacked.

enhancements.name: Inspired to Greatness
enhancements.body: MAGUS/PRIMUS model only. This unit’s attacks can re-roll **[gloss:damage-roll:Damage rolls]**.

enhancements.name: Devious Disguises
enhancements.body: NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit only. This unit has -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

armyRule.name: Gate of Infinity
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is GREY KNIGHTS, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, you can select a number of units (see below) from your army that are on the battlefield (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), provided every model in those units has this ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
▪ **Incursion:** Up to 2 units.
▪ **Strike Force:** Up to 3 units.
▪ **Onslaught:** Up to 4 units.

▪ Place those units in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.
▪ Those units can make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]** in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

rule.name: Prescient Redeployment
rule.body:
From the second battle round onwards, at the start of your Movement phase, if you did not select the maximum number of Grey Knights units from your army using the Gate of Infinity ability at the end of your opponent’s previous turn, you can select one GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is on the battlefield that could have been selected using the Gate of Infinity ability. Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

**Designer’s Note:** This means that your unit can retain its position on the battlefield at the end of your Command phase, and then be placed into Strategic Reserves at the start of your Movement phase, to set it up again in your Reinforcements step in another position.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Anticipation
stratagems.sublabel: Augurium Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Appointed Hour
stratagems.sublabel: Augurium Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Forewarned Evasion
stratagems.sublabel: Augurium Task Force – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS WALKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Necessary End
stratagems.sublabel: Augurium Task Force – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Redirected Strike
stratagems.sublabel: Augurium Task Force – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

**Designer’s Note:** This Stratagem lets players utilise abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.

stratagems.name: Mirage of Echoes
stratagems.sublabel: Augurium Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Channelled Force
rule.body:
Each time a GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army is selected to fight, that unit can take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, select one of the following rules. Until the end of the phase, that unit has that rule.
▪ Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
▪ Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

rule.name: Duty Before All
rule.body: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Giants of the Battlefield
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Grind Them Underfoot
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: Unending Fidelity
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Shining Resolve
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Precognitive Strategies
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Purgation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.

enhancements.name: Eye of the Augurium
enhancements.body:
GREY KNIGHTS model only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**, regardless of any other uses of that **Stratagem** this phase. If you do:
▪ That use is -1 CP.
▪ That use does not prevent any uses of that **Stratagem** on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Inescapable Judgement (Psychic)
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit Falls Back, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

enhancements.name: Sanctic Reaper
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR model only. Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Nemesis Rounds
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem.

rule.name: Mailed Fist
rule.body: Each time a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: Abominus-Class Targets
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Will
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Argent Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: Force Wave
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Redoubled Assault
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Armoured Aegis
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Driven by Duty
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS WALKER model only. Each time the bearer’s unit Piles In or Consolidates, the bearer can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

enhancements.name: Quickening Foci
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. In your Movement phase, each time the bearer’s unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Sigil of Exigence
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, in your opponent’s Shooting phase, when the bearer’s unit is selected as the target of a ranged attack, you can remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and then set it back up again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units. If the bearer’s unit is no longer an eligible target, your opponent can then select new targets for any attacks that had targeted the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Spiritus Machina
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if the bearer’s unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rule.name: Hallowed Ground
rule.body:
Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army’s Hallowed Ground, as follows:
▪ Your deployment zone is always within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
▪ The area of the battlefield within 6" of one or more Purifier Squad units from your army is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
▪ At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man’s Land, until the end of that phase, No Man’s Land is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
▪ At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent’s deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent’s deployment zone is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
Each time a model in a GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible target or makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD and/or is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Kill Zone
stratagems.sublabel: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a Purifier Squad.

stratagems.name: Hallowed Beacon
stratagems.sublabel: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding Terminator units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Fires of Covenant
stratagems.sublabel: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Aegis Eternal
stratagems.sublabel: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Repelling Sphere
stratagems.sublabel: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

stratagems.name: Flames of Sanctity
stratagems.sublabel: Warpbane Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Purifier Squad unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes Castellan Crowe: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Mandulian Reliquary
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS model only. While the bearer’s unit is not Battle-shocked, add 3 to the bearer’s Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Radiant Champion
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability, and while the bearer is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, each time a melee attack made by the bearer scores a wound, the target of that attack suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to any normal damage.

enhancements.name: Phial of the Abyss
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Paragon of Sanctity
enhancements.body: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can select one friendly GREY KNIGHTS unit within 18" of and visible to it. If it does, until the end of the phase, that unit is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

rule.name: Dauntless Champions
rule.body: When a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**, if the S of those attacks is lower than the T of the target, those attacks have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Aegis
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 4+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.

stratagems.name: A Threat Ended
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Aura of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit’s melee attacks have [HAZARDOUS].

enhancements.name: Psychic Celerity
enhancements.body: TERMINATOR model only. This unit has +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.

enhancements.name: Vigilance of Titan
enhancements.body: TERMINATOR model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

rule.name: Searing Soulflame
rule.body: When you select a unit to be **[gloss:pinned:pinned]** by a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit’s Righteous Persecution ability, that enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: Soul-locked
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Focused Immolation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have:
▪ [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
▪ [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Spiritsear
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one Battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit suffers D3+1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.

enhancements.name: Precognicient Volleys
enhancements.body: PURGATION SQUAD unit only. This unit’s **[gloss:snap-shooting:snap shooting]** attacks hit on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

enhancements.name: Boons of Deimos
enhancements.body: PURGATION SQUAD unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +2 S.

rule.name: Echojump
rule.body:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do:
▪ That unit cannot use its Personal Teleporters ability.
▪ That unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6+1".

stratagems.name: Blades from the Beyond
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a **[gloss:charge-move:Charge move]** this turn is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: By Thought Alone
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit **[gloss:action:starts an Action]**.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That **[gloss:action:Action]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.

stratagems.name: Responsive Displacement
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a fall-back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Predestined Coordinates
enhancements.body: INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**.

enhancements.name: Astral Overlap
enhancements.body: INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit only. This unit has [core:Stealth].

armyRule.name: Prioritised Efficiency
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is LEAGUES OF VOTANN, LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army have one of two abilities: **Hostile Acquisition** or **Fortify Takeover** (see below). During the battle, which ability those LEAGUES OF VOTANN units have will change depending on how many Yield points (YP) you currently have:
▪ At the start of the battle, your units have Hostile Acquisition until the start of your next Command phase.
▪ At the end of your Command phase, if you have fewer than 7YP, your units have Hostile Acquisition until the start of your next Command phase.
▪ At the end of your Command phase, if you have 7YP or more, your units have Fortify Takeover until the start of your next Command phase.

### Hostile Acquisition
▪ Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll.
▪ You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

### Fortify Takeover
▪ Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if this unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control, add 1 to the Hit roll.
▪ Each time an attack targets this unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than this unit's Toughness characteristic and this unit is not a VEHICLE, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

### Yield Points
At the end of each player's Command phase, you gain 1YP if you control one or more objective markers within your deployment zone, and, from the second battle round onwards, you gain 1 additional YP for each of the following conditions you satisfy:
▪ You control one or more objective markers not within your deployment zone.
▪ You control two or more objective markers not within your deployment zone.
▪ You control more objective markers than your opponent.

In your turn, YP gained in this way are always gained before checking which ability LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army have. Whenever a rule allows you to spend YP, reduce the number of YP you have by that amount (your YP cannot go below 0), otherwise you cannot use that rule.

**Designer's Note:** This means you can use rules that let you gain or spend YP to influence which ability your units have — Hostile Acquisition or Fortify Takeover — depending on which will be most beneficial to you. Remember that your army only changes ability at the end of your Command phase, so you will sometimes need to plan ahead if you want your army to stay in or change ability.
