stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move. When doing so, your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker.

stratagems.name: First Concern
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Brôkhyr, Ironkin Steeljacks or Arkanyst Evaluator unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That BRÔKHYR, IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: If your unit Remained Stationary in your Movement phase this turn, it can make a Normal move.

stratagems.name: Preventative Purge
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Brôkhyr Thunderkyn or Ironkin Steeljacks unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. When doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Delayed-Fire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Brôkhyr, Ironkin Steeljacks or Arkanyst Evaluator unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That BRÔKHYR, IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time that enemy unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, roll one D6 for each model in that unit: for each 1, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

enhancements.name: Fârstrydr Node
enhancements.body: Iron-master or Memnyr Strategist model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Calculated Tenacity
enhancements.body: Iron-master or Memnyr Strategist model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Mantle of Elders
enhancements.body: Memnyr Strategist model only. Each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if you spend YP using the Optimal Application Detachment rule when doing so, you can roll one D6: on a 2+, you gain 1YP.

enhancements.name: Graviton Vault
enhancements.body: Iron-master model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, and in the Fight phase, after the bearer has fought, select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rule.name: Ruthless Reinvestment
rule.body: Your Leagues of Votann units do not have the Hostile Acquisition or Fortify Takeover abilities except as described in this rule. At the start of the battle, your LEAGUES OF VOTANN units have the Hostile Acquisition ability. At the end of your Command phase, you can spend 3YP. If you do, LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army lose the Hostile Acquisition ability and gain the Fortify Takeover ability, or vice versa.

stratagems.name: Auxiliary Contract
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY or LEAGUES OF VOTANN MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: New Horizons
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit from your army that is not within Engagement range of one or more enemy units and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

stratagems.name: Grand Artifice
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Mobile Exploitation
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Alternatively, you can spend 2YP and target up to two HERNKYN units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units instead.
stratagems.effect: Remove your units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Optimal Expenditure
stratagems.when: The Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this usage of this Stratagem, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Privateer Arsenal
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this usage of this Stratagem, you can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll a Wound roll of 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Mercenary Prospector
enhancements.body: Kâhl model only. Each time an enemy unit is destroyed by the bearer’s unit, gain 2YP.

enhancements.name: Metaphysical Brokerage
enhancements.body: Memnyr Strategist model only. At the end of your turn, if the bearer is on the battlefield and you gained fewer than 3YP this turn, you gain an amount of YP equal to the difference.

enhancements.name: Etacarn SB9 Targeting Implant
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can spend 3YP. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

enhancements.name: Asset Manipulator
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. At the start of the Command phase, you can spend 3YP. If you do, until the end of the turn, while an enemy unit is within 3" of the bearer, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit.

rule.name: Martial Leverage
rule.body: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain 1YP.

stratagems.name: Ancestral Sentence
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.

stratagems.name: Honour of the Hold
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 instead.

stratagems.name: Huntr’s Mark
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Reactive Reprisal

stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, can only target that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

stratagems.name: Void Hardened
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Oathbound Speculator
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can spend 3YP. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Dead Reckoning
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. At the end of the turn, if the bearer is on the battlefield and you spent no YP in that turn, you can gain 1YP.

enhancements.name: Iron Ambassador
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model equipped with an Autoch-pattern combi-bolter only. Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, spend up to 3YP and, until the end of the phase, add the number of YP you just spent to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s ranged weapons.

enhancements.name: Ancestral Crest
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Once per turn, when you target the bearer’s unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, spend 1YP and reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

rule.name: Assailed From Every Angle
rule.body:
LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army have the following ability:

**Guerrilla Adepts:** In your Shooting phase, just after this unit is selected to shoot, this unit can use this ability. If it does, select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). Until the end of the phase, attacks made by models in this unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and, after resolving those attacks, if one or more of those attacks hit that enemy unit, until the start of your next Shooting phase, that enemy unit is assailed (this simply labels that unit for the purposes of this ability and some Enhancements and Stratagems). If that unit is already assailed, until the start of your next Shooting phase, it is also pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: Ranger Tactics
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that attack targets an assailed unit and/or if your unit has the Hernkyn keyword, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Frontier Momentum
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Exposed Flaws
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem and/or if that attack targets an assailed unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Dispersed Formation
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY or LEAGUES OF VOTANN MOUNTED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

stratagems.name: Claimstaker Reflex
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army (excluding Artillery and VEHICLE units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
stratagems.restrictions: A unit cannot embark within a TRANSPORT as part of this move.

stratagems.name: Adaptable Avarice
stratagems.when: Start of any phase, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend any number of YP. Once you have done so, if you have 6 or fewer YP, until the start of your next turn, units from your army have Hostile Acquisition instead.

enhancements.name: Eye for Weakness
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets an assailed unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Writ of Acquisition
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, you gain 1YP for each assailed enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (to a maximum of 3YP).

enhancements.name: Surgical Saboteur
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, select one MONSTER or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks; until the start of your next Shooting phase, that unit is pinned.

enhancements.name: Nomad Strategist
enhancements.body: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend up to 4YP. Select one Hernkyn unit from your army, and, for every 2YP you just spent, select up to one additional HERNKYN unit from your army. You can remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units (excluding assailed units).

stratagems.target: Up to two friendly SAGITAUR units.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit. Your units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can:
▪ Re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
▪ Re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units’ attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERNKYN unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That HERNKYN unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.target: That PIONEERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Pan-spectral Lockons
enhancements.body: PIONEERS unit only. In your Shooting phase, you can select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit is spotted: while a unit is spotted, that unit has +3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

enhancements.name: Shroudwërke Talismans
enhancements.body: YAEGIRS unit only. This unit has -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

rule.name: Avatars of the Ancestors
rule.body:
Friendly KÂHL/EINHYR CHAMPION/EINHYR HEARTHGUARD/ÛTHAR THE DESTINED units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **HEARTHGUARD** tag and cannot be taken with another **HEARTHGUARD** **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Brëkkeknots
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit.
stratagems.target: That EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has 4+ InSv.

stratagems.name: Fury of the Hearth
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
▪ +1 S.
▪ If you spend 1 YP, [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Materialisation Matrices
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit with [core:Deep Strike] is selected to make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**.
stratagems.target: That EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.
▪ Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

In the Fight phase, when a model in this unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if this unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield; after this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

armyRule.name: Reanimation Protocols
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is NECRONS, at the end of your Command phase, each friendly unit with this ability that is on the battlefield activates its Reanimation Protocols:
▪ When a unit's Reanimation Protocols activate, that unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** D3 wounds.
armyRule.example: A unit of Lokhust Destroyers (which have a Wounds characteristic of 3) activates its Reanimation Protocols. The unit had a Starting Strength of 3, but currently contains 2 models, and one of those models has lost 1 wound. A 3 is rolled to see how many wounds are reanimated. The first of these reanimated wounds restores the wounded Lokhust Destroyer back to 3 wounds. The second of these reanimated wounds returns the destroyed Lokhust Destroyer to the battlefield with 1 wound remaining. The third of these reanimated wounds restores one of the remaining lost wounds to the same Lokhust Destroyer that was just returned. The unit now contains 3 models, two of which have 3 wounds remaining and one of which has 2 wounds remaining.

rule.name: Command Protocols
rule.body: While a NECRONS CHARACTER model is leading this unit, each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Eternal Revenant
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: At the end of the phase, set up the **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was **destroyed**. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]** of 1. That model has half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
stratagems.restrictions: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Undying Legions
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit).

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration).

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Vengeful Stars

stratagems.target: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6" of that Necrons unit when it was destroyed.
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Each time a Destroyer Cult or Flayed Ones unit from your army declares a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll. If one or more targets of that charge are Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Charge roll as well.

Each time a Destroyer Cult unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, add 1 to the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack.

rule.name: Power Matrix
rule.body:
Certain areas of the battlefield are considered to be within your army's Power Matrix, as follows:
▪ Your deployment zone is always within your army's Power Matrix.
▪ At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man's Land, until the end of that phase, No Man's Land is within your army's Power Matrix.
▪ At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent's deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent's deployment zone is within your army's Power Matrix.

Each time a model in a Cryptek or Canoptek unit from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If such a unit is wholly within your army's Power Matrix, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.target: One Cryptek model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit's attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Canoptek model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.target: One Cryptek or Canoptek unit from your army that is wholly within your army's Power Matrix.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by Cryptek or Canoptek models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.target: One Cryptek model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker within 18" of your Cryptek model. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting units within range of that objective marker.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.target: One Canoptek unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

rule.name: Hyperphasing
rule.body:
At the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of NECRONS units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
▪ Incursion: Up to 1 unit
▪ Strike Force: Up to 2 units
▪ Onslaught: Up to 3 units

Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks and one friendly Monolith model.
stratagems.effect: Remove your INFANTRY unit from the battlefield and then set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of your Monolith model and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Your NECRONS WARLORD.
stratagems.effect: For each of your NECRONS units in Reserves, that Reserves unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER units) that is arriving using an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]** this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: Dimensional Corridor
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield this turn using the Eternity Gate ability of a Monolith model that started the turn on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is eligible to charge this phase.

stratagems.name: Entropic Damping
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TITANIC model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 18" of the attacking unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Overseer
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add one to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Hyperphasing rule.

enhancements.name: Arisen Tyrant
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the bearer's unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

enhancements.name: Hyperspatial Transfer Node
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. Each time the bearer's unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Osteoclave Fulcrum
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability.

rule.name: Worthy Foes
rule.body: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a Noble, Lychguard or Triarch unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Your Time Is Nigh
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after your opponent's WARLORD is destroyed.
stratagems.target: Your NECRONS WARLORD.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.

stratagems.name: Enslaved Artifice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Nanoassembly Protocols
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Sentinels of Eternity
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Lychguard or Triarch Praetorians unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Suffer No Rival
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Lychguard or Triarch unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Territorial Obsession
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Lychguard or Triarch unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. If your unit has the VEHICLE keyword, add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic instead.

enhancements.name: Honourable Combatant
enhancements.body: Overlord model only. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, your opponent loses 1CP if they have any.

enhancements.name: Unflinching Will
enhancements.body: Overlord model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] and [ANTI-INFANTRY 5+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Warrior Noble
enhancements.body: Overlord model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Eternal Conqueror
enhancements.body: Overlord model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rule.name: Hypermotility Protocols
rule.body:
▪ Friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS units' ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
▪ When a friendly Immortals/Necron Warriors unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to start an action.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the Dynasty tag and cannot be taken with another Dynasty **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Dominance Protocols
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Immortals unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Will of the Conqueror
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Nanosaturation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using **[gloss:snap-shooting:snap shooting]**, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Enlivened Sentinels
enhancements.body: NECRON WARRIORS unit only. This unit has [core:Scouts 5"].

enhancements.name: Tools of Dominion
enhancements.body: Immortals unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have [RAPID FIRE 1].

rule.name: Transdimensional Deployment
rule.body:
▪ Friendly Tomb Blades units have [core:Deep Strike].
▪ When a friendly Tomb Blades unit is selected to shoot, if that unit made an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]** this turn, that unit's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Omnilocked Strafing
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Swift as Death
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.target: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Evasive Protocols
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.target: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Recursive Reanimation
enhancements.body: Tomb Blades unit only. When this unit activates its Reanimation Protocols, +1 to the roll.

enhancements.name: Deepening Madness
enhancements.body: Destroyer Cult Mounted unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

rule.name: Empowered Engines
rule.body:
Friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY units have +6" M.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the Hypercrypt tag and cannot be taken with another Hypercrypt **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Subsurface Quantumweave
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.
stratagems.target: That NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Particle Pulse
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

stratagems.name: Cosmic Storm
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Obelisk/Tesseract Vault unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That Obelisk/Tesseract Vault unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Tesla Sphere weapons have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Prelocational Optimiser
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, if this unit was set up using a Monolith's Eternity Gate ability this turn, this unit's ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS], or [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Mortality Shroud
enhancements.body: Obelisk unit only. In your opponent's Battle-shock step, if an enemy unit within 8" of this unit is below **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]**, that enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll.

rule.name: Relentless Onslaught
rule.body: Each time a NECRONS model (excluding MONSTER models) from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll. In addition, ranged weapons equipped by NECRONS VEHICLE and NECRONS MOUNTED models (excluding TITANIC models) from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: Merciless Reclamation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Unyielding Forms
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Chronoshift
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Dimensional Tunnel
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.

stratagems.name: Endless Servitude
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: Reactive Reposition
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) that was the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

enhancements.name: Dread Majesty
enhancements.body: Overlord or Catacomb Command Barge model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Miniaturised Nebuloscope
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Demanding Leader
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Chrono-impedance Fields
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in that unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rule.name: Techno-sorcerous Augmentations
rule.body:
▪ Ranged weapons equipped by Cryptek models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.
▪ In your Shooting phase, each time a Cryptek unit from your army is selected to shoot, select one of the following abilities: [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+], [ANTI-MOUNTED 4+], [ASSAULT], [HEAVY], [IGNORES COVER]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have that ability.

stratagems.name: Molecular Targeting
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the Cryptek keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Microscarab Swarm
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CRYPTEK INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the NECRON WARRIORS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the Immortals keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Animus Curse
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit's attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Synergistic Empowerment
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly NECRONS model (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 12" of a Cryptek model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly Necrons model has the Cryptek keyword.

stratagems.name: Untapped Power
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Techno-sorcerous Augmentations Detachment rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.

stratagems.name: Potentiality Syphon
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Command phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a Cryptek unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.

enhancements.name: Quantum Abacus
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. Each time you select the bearer's unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if it is within range of one or more objectives: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Atomic Disintegrators
enhancements.body: Cryptek model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer's unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment rule, you can also select from the following abilities: [ANTI-MONSTER 5+], [ANTI-VEHICLE 5+].

enhancements.name: Gauntlet of Compression
enhancements.body: NECRONS model only. Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Gravitic Bolas
enhancements.body: Cryptek model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding TITANIC units); until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit's Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

rule.name: Cold Fervour
rule.body:
▪ Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by Destroyer Cult models from your army.
▪ The first time each turn that a Destroyer Cult unit from your army makes attacks that destroy a unit or cause it to become Below Half-strength, after that unit has finished resolving its attacks, until the end of the turn, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models (excluding Destroyer Cult, MONSTER and TITANIC models).

stratagems.name: Methodical Murder
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Image of Death
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Mortis Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a Destroyer Cult unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
stratagems.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 9" of that Destroyer Cult unit.
stratagems.effect: The friendly unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: Driven to Butchery
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: Spreading Madness
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.

stratagems.name: Unnatural Aggression
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.

enhancements.name: Destroyer Ankh
enhancements.body: Catacomb Command Barge or Overlord model only. The bearer has the Destroyer Cult keyword. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit and add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Murdermind
enhancements.body: Cryptek model only. The bearer has the DESTROYER CULT keyword. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Nekrosor
enhancements.body: Destroyer Cult model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Cursed Circlet
enhancements.body: Destroyer Cult model only. In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit was **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** by those attacks, this unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6".

rule.name: Cosmic Distortion
rule.body:
NECRONS MONSTER units from your army have the following ability:

Distortion Fields (Aura): While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, it is unravelling. While an enemy unit is unravelling, each time an attack targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

At the start of each phase, for each Necrons Monster unit from your army, that unit can suffer 3 mortal wounds. If it does, until the end of the phase, the range of that unit's Distortion Fields Aura ability is increased to 9".

Designer's Note: If your army contains more than one Transcendent C'tan unit, each of those units must take the Reletavistic Tether ability.

When mustering your army, each Necrons Monster unit from your army has the relevant Necrodermal Binding ability shown below, and you must increase the points cost of each of those units by the amount shown in the Munitorum Field Manual. If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.

Necrodermal Binding Abilities

This eldritch device fetters and directs the Deceiver's powers within a vortex that devours lesser wits entirely. C'tan Shard of the Deceiver model only. This model has the following ability: Lord of Deceit (Aura): Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

The energies of this binding latch onto enemy targets and shunt the shard into alignment with them. C'tan Shard of the Nightbringer model only. This model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

This device bleeds off the Void Dragon shard's energies and earths them violently through nearby machines. C'tan Shard of the Void Dragon model only. Once per turn, at the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if that Leadership test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

This binding uses atomic resonance magnetism to compel the shard into the midst of the foe. Transcendent C'tan model only. In your turn, when this unit makes an ingress/advance move using its Transdimensional Displacement ability, this unit can end that move more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"). When this unit ends that move within 8" of an enemy unit, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Disharmonisation Cascade
stratagems.sublabel: Pantheon of Woe – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.
stratagems.target: That NECRONS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of on a 6.

stratagems.name: Molecular Erosion
stratagems.sublabel: Pantheon of Woe – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one unravelling enemy unit visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result. If that test is failed, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Mass Transmogrification
stratagems.sublabel: Pantheon of Woe – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) within 6" of that Monster unit.
stratagems.effect: If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: Entrophasic Aura Targeting
stratagems.sublabel: Pantheon of Woe – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Chronodistortion
stratagems.sublabel: Pantheon of Woe – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Phase Melding
stratagems.sublabel: Pantheon of Woe – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

enhancements.name: Singularity Matrix
enhancements.body: C'tan Shard of the Deceiver model only. This model has the following ability: Lord of Deceit (Aura): Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that **Stratagem** by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Quantum Goad
enhancements.body: C'tan Shard of the Nightbringer model only. This model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Animus Damper
enhancements.body: C'tan Shard of the Void Dragon model only. Once per turn, at the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, select one enemy Vehicle unit visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if that Leadership test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Reletavistic Tether
enhancements.body: TRANSCENDENT C'TAN model only. wargearAbilities.text: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

wargearAbilities.name: Weapon Support System
wargearAbilities.text: Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

wargearAbilities.name: Marker Drone
wargearAbilities.text: The bearer’s unit has the Markerlight keyword and can act as an Observer unit for another unit even if it Advanced this turn.

wargearAbilities.name: Shield Drone
wargearAbilities.text: Add 1 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic.

datasheets.name: Y’vahra Battlesuit

abilities.name: Battlesuit Support System

abilities.name: Nova Burst
abilities.text: Once per battle, before this model makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, it has a Move characteristic of 18".
